map.由折射率与两表面曲率半径，按 1/f = (n-1)(1/R₁ - 1/R₂): From refractive index and both surface radii of curvature, compute lens focal length as 1/f = (n-1)(1/R1 - 1/R2).
map.填写「前表面曲率半径 R₁ (mm)」。: Fill in 'front surface radius of curvature R1 (mm)'.
map.填写「后表面曲率半径 R₂ (mm)」。: Fill in 'back surface radius of curvature R2 (mm)'.
map.由折射率与两面曲率半径算焦距。: Focal length from refractive index and both surface radii of curvature.
map.验光片焦距反推曲率。: Back out curvature from trial lens focal length.
map.曲率半径符号怎么定？: How is the sign of the radius of curvature set?
map.光线从左到右，凸向入射面为正、凹向为负；符号错焦距正负反。: Light travels left to right; convex toward the incoming surface is positive and concave is negative; a sign error reverses the focal length sign.
map.薄透镜才准吗？: Is it accurate only for thin lenses?
map.此式为薄透镜近似，厚透镜用矩阵/厚透镜公式，中心厚不可忽略时误差显。: This is the thin lens approximation; thick lenses need the matrix or thick lens formula, and error is obvious when centre thickness cannot be ignored.
